rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something is performed or acted out again, rather than specifically recreating a historical event.

example.english: We will reenact the play on stage next week.
example.traditional: 我哋下星期喺台上面將套劇再演一次。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 hai2 toi1 soeng6 min6 zoeng1 tou3 kek6 zoi3 jin2 jat1 ci3

rows.note: Use this especially when recreating a past event, scene, or battle, though it can also mean performing something again.

example.english: The villagers reenact this ancient battle every year.
example.traditional: 村民每年都會重演呢場古代戰役。
example.jyutping: cyun1 man4 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 cung4 jin2 ne1 coeng4 gu2 doi6 zin3 jik6
